name: SQL Query
description: Runs a read-only SQL query (SELECT) against a named database and returns the rows. 'db' names a venue-local convex-db database (per-user, lattice-backed, created on first use) or an operator-registered JDBC connection. Use params with ? placeholders for values — safer than interpolating them into the statement. Results are capped at maxRows (default 1000) with truncated: true when more rows were available.

statement.description: SQL SELECT statement, optionally with ? placeholders

truncated.description: Present and true when more rows were available than maxRows
